# Speed of one step of the chain of the log, per hash
What: ns for one step next(previous, index, entry): hash over the previous chain value, the 8-byte index and the entry.
Input: one entry of 64 B, 1 KiB or 64 KiB, filled with i*131+7. 512 KiB per sample, at least 16 entries; 31 samples per run; 3 rounds, the binaries run alternately.
Arms: crc32c (Google crc32c, tree deps/crc32c), crc_aa (the same source, a second binary, the noise floor), hydro32 (libhydrogen hydro_hash, 32 B, tree deps/libhydrogen), sha256, sha512_256 and blake2b256 (OpenSSL EVP, one EVP_MD fetched once, one EVP_MD_CTX), blake3 (libblake3 hasher, 32 B).
Builds: Release, -O3 by CMake, C++23, one binary per arm and compiler.
Container: podman --cpus=3 on 4 processors, image localhost/hashbench (localhost/cxx-matrix-sqlite + Ubuntu libssl-dev, libblake3-dev). Run as user bench (uid 1001), not root, not pinned.
Source digests (sha256): bench.cpp d672cf6650ef73f8b7904214373bf2204e901cc97335cee6854eb79c610f0f72 CMakeLists.txt db8f6c5c9765968d14babd3a2804d8a63a5e65c4968ca64b466098bec0fc6039 run-inside.sh b54967b0289ffdfcd45b8f1fb007de6f87909629e6aad49e5ff07aa223233385
